snippet.title: Europa Universalis IV: Golden Century - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Golden Century on Steam https://pdxint.at/2L7CRc2 
Golden Century on Paradox Store: https://pdxint.at/2Px14sQ

Golden Century is now available! From Madrid to Mexico to Manila, the Spanish Crown had the one of the first empires where the sun never set. Continue the reconquista, expand your colonial empire, or become a pirate king fighting the flagships of mighty  empires while raiding their trade routes?
